UPI QR (upi://pay and EMVCo-format Bharat QR) is ubiquitous at merchants. BRAKE can parse pa, pn, mc, am and tr and hand off to the user's UPI app via an Android chooser. iOS hand-off is unpredictable: the target is undefined for duplicate schemes, and LSApplicationQueriesSchemes is capped at 25 for apps linked on iOS 27+. NPCI constraints on non-PSP relay are unverified.
EMV MPM with card tags 02/04/06 and UPI templates 26-28.

Any app can declare the upi scheme and Android shows a disambiguation dialog; user defaults and explicit-package SDKs bypass it. NPCI OC-73 (2019): UPI apps should respond to merchant intents only if the user is registered with a UPI PIN in that app (to avoid clutter and timeouts). OC-76A/76C: P2P intents and intents to offline non-verified merchants are disallowed, so only verified/online P2M intents exist. Play policy position unverified.
iOS: if multiple apps register the same scheme the target is undefined, and there is no chooser.
OC-220 (29 Jul 2025): P2P collect not processed from 1 Oct 2025. Collect remains for P2M.

24 h PDN norm; exempt FASTag MCC 4784 and NCMC MCC 7412 (OC-207). AFA threshold Rs 1,00,000 for mutual funds, insurance premiums and credit-card bills (OC-151A, quoting RBI 12 Dec 2023). Execution: max 1 attempt + 3 retries, non-peak hours (OC-215A). Mandate view/port across apps (OC-223, 7 Oct 2025).
Rs 1,000 per transaction, Rs 5,000 total (OC-169A, after RBI 4 Dec 2024); auto top-up (OC-205). Banks send consolidated periodic debit SMS, not one per payment (OC-138).

Full delegation Rs 5,000 per transaction / Rs 15,000 per month (OC-201, 13 Aug 2024). OC-201B extends it to IoT devices, software and AI profiles (CUG), domestic P2M only, purpose code BH in the raw file; no 'MIC' in the circular text.
Limit = lowest of the issuer credit limit, the issuer UPI risk limit and the customer limit (RuPay OC-022). Barred for CBDC top-ups (OC-170B).
Pre-sanctioned bank credit lines for merchant payments (OC-171); purpose-bound since OC-171A (FY2025-26).

Single-Block-Multiple-Debits (OC-200, 31 Jul 2024), extended to all funding sources (OC-228, 8 Oct 2025). Block <= Rs 10,000, <= 90 days, one block per mobile per merchant, online verified low-ticket merchants first.
On-device biometrics as an optional alternative to the UPI PIN, initially for transactions up to Rs 5,000; UIDAI face auth for PIN set/reset (OC-226, 7 Oct 2025).

MCC 7407 assigned to P2PM (Circular 70; reiterated in OC-181). Inward caps Rs 10,000 per transaction, 25,000 per day, 1,00,000 per 30 days (OC-192); Rs 1L/month for 3 consecutive months forces P2M onboarding.
For P2P and P2PM transactions, UPI apps must show only the banking name from the Validate Address API, not QR or user-defined names (OC-101A, 24 Apr 2025; compliance 30 Jun 2025). Does not cover P2M.

May 2026 shares (PhonePe ~46%, Google Pay ~33%, Paytm ~8%; PhonePe+GPay ~79%) come only from unreachable secondary posts (unverified; volume vs value unclear). Confirmed: 30% TPAP cap compliance deadline 31 Dec 2026 (OC-210), with no later change in the index up to ~May 2026.
NFC UPI on Android and iOS, initiation mode 06; amounts up to Rs 500 go via UPI Lite if enabled (OC-186, 19 Dec 2023). No payload visible to BRAKE.
EMV profile GUI br.gov.bcb.pix; txid in 62.05 ('***' static); dynamic location URL in 26.25.

Recurrence objects (Rec, SolicRec, CobR, LocRec) since API 2.7.0-RC1, current 2.10.0. BCB examples carry the recurrence in BR Code tag 80 (GUI br.gov.bcb.pix, 25 = /rec/ location); journeys JORNADA_1-4. Launch date unverified.
Pix por aproximacao reportedly live since 2025 (unverified); no third-party-visible payload.
Tag 26 SG.PAYNOW, proxy type 0 mobile / 2 UEN; SGQR spec v1.7.
Tag 29 GUID A000000677010111; mobile/tax ID/e-wallet proxies; currency 764.
Tag 26 GUID A0000006150001 (PayNet); currency 458.
MAI 26-45 per PJSP, tag 51 NMID, merchant criteria UMI..URE; currency 360.
Tag 38 GUID A000000727; BIN + account; service codes QRIBFTTA/QRIBFTTC (transfer), QRPUSH (merchant payment), QRCASH (ATM); currency 704.
Bakong name@bank IDs; tag 99 timestamp/expiry; KHR 116 / USD 840; MD5 lookup key.
EMVCo-based national QR. Secondary (reverse-engineered vectors): P2P tag 27 GUID com.p2pqrpay, P2M tag 28 GUID ph.ppmi.p2m, sub-tag 01 acquirer BIC.
CBK Kenya Quick Response Code Standard (EMVCo-based) exists; adoption not assessed.
Per-transaction SMS with a receipt code (format unverified). Android only, subject to Play SMS policy.
Merchant-side Daraja API only; not available to consumer apps.
ePayment API merchant-side (NOK/DKK/EUR); consumer observability only via notifications/PSD2.
As for NO; DKK supported.
As for NO; EUR supported.
Merchant-side Open Payment API (dynamic QR, merchantPaymentId, 4-5 s polling). No consumer API.
Instant Payments Regulation send/receive and VoP obligations in force by Oct 2025 (unverified in session). Observed via PSD2 feeds.
No domestic UPI; card rails and FedNow/RTP dominate. Observe via bank feeds.
Instant rails exist but have no consumer-side observability. Limits unverified.
TLV with MAI 02-25 (networks) / 26-51 (operators); CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE poly 0x1021 init 0xFFFF.
Chrome 60+, Chrome Android 53+, Edge 15+, Safari 11.1+, Android WebView 136+; Firefox 55 only behind prefs (as of 2026-10-04).
Chromium only (Chrome/Edge 95+, mirrored by Opera and Samsung Internet); not Firefox, Safari or Android WebView; experimental. availability() Chrome 139, capabilities() Chrome 148.
Apple Pay JS (iOS 10+/macOS 10.12+) and Payment Request (iOS 11.3+/Safari 11.1+). Different availability in China. Sheet not observable.

LSApplicationQueriesSchemes max 50 (apps linked on iOS 15+) and 25 (linked on iOS 27+); canOpenURL returns false for undeclared schemes. open(_:options:completionHandler:) is NOT constrained by this list, so it limits detection only, not hand-off.
Android 15: untrusted NotificationListenerService apps get redacted content for notifications where an OTP is detected.

Payer PSPs must disallow P2P intent-based transactions (initiation modes 04 and 05) per OC-76A (12 Mar 2024), reaffirmed in OC-76C (8 Apr 2025, effective 30 Apr 2025). Intents are also disallowed for all offline non-verified merchants.
Paying from a shared QR image is capped at Rs 2,000 for P2P and non-verified offline P2M, and not allowed for UPI Global P2M (OC-76/76C). This affects BRAKE's 'share QR to your UPI app' hand-off.
OC-215A (FY2025-26): issuer banks shall add the available balance to every successful UPI financial transaction communication. Actual bank compliance not measured.

Android 17: WebOTP-format SMS withheld for 3 hours from SMS-permission apps that are not the domain-verified recipient; applies to all apps regardless of target SDK; default SMS and companion apps exempt [V].

All Gmail read scopes (gmail.readonly, gmail.metadata, gmail.modify, mail.google.com) are restricted. Production use requires verification, plus an annual security assessment for apps that access Gmail data from or through a server. A local-client exemption was in 2022 policy text but is absent from the 15 Feb 2024 User Data Policy, so it is unverified for 2026. Unverified apps have a 100-new-user lifetime cap. As of 2026-10-04.
The q parameter and format=full/raw cannot be used with the gmail.metadata scope (discovery doc revision 20260727).
Gmail search operators category:purchases and category:reservations are usable in q with gmail.readonly.
gmail.addons.current.message.readonly/metadata are sensitive (not restricted) and expose only the open message (classification per 2026 secondary sources).
Mail.Read and Mail.ReadBasic (delegated) are consentable by personal Microsoft accounts with no admin consent. Mail.ReadBasic excludes body, previewBody, attachments and extended properties.

Message subscriptions work for personal accounts. Latency is under 1 minute average and 3 minutes max. Max lifetime is 10,080 minutes (1,440 with resource data), with up to 1,000 subscriptions per mailbox.
Basic auth and app passwords for Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live and MSN IMAP were switched off on 16 Sep 2024; only XOAUTH2 works (secondary source).

Since 2021, the default outbound-spam setting ('Automatic – System-controlled') has meant automatic external forwarding is Off for new orgs and for existing orgs that weren't actively using it; orgs already using it may still forward. Blocked mail fails with 5.7.520. Microsoft Learn mirror dated 2026-08-18.

iCloud Mail IMAP at imap.mail.me.com:993 with an app-specific password, per FairEmail's provider config and FAQ (which links Apple support). No third-party OAuth for IMAP (unverified). As of 2026-10-04.

Conflicting evidence. FairEmail's FAQ (fetched 2026-10-04) says Yahoo 'no longer allows users to log in using just an (app) password' and requires OAuth, and its Yahoo app-password profile is disabled. The date and scope of the change are unverified, and Yahoo OAuth for IMAP is believed to require client approval.

ML Kit GenAI Prompt API on Gemini Nano requires at least 1.0.0-beta4 and minSdk 26. Structured output via @Generable uses genai-schema-compiler 1.0.0-alpha1, and availability is per device via FeatureStatus. Whether a stable release exists is unverified. As of 2026-09-03.

Introduced in iOS/iPadOS/macOS 26.0 (non-beta), with @Generable guided generation. It requires a device that supports Apple Intelligence. As of Oct 2026, the framework also routes to Private Cloud Compute or server models, so apps must choose the on-device model to keep data local.
The vocabulary is stable (Order, Invoice, ParcelDelivery, Reservation), but 2026 prevalence in transactional email is unmeasured.
Email alerts are not mandated (RBI/2017-18/15: SMS mandatory, email optional) and vary by bank. ICICI is reportedly NRI-only and SBI reportedly unsuitable. Secondary source, 2026.
HDFC reportedly emails every UPI transaction, including the 12-digit UPI reference number, even below its SMS thresholds introduced 25 Jun 2024. A 2026 sample confirms the format.

RBI Digital Payments – E-mandate Framework, 2026 (RBI/DPSS/2026-27/396, 21 Apr 2026) covers recurring payments on cards, PPIs and UPI. Issuers must send a pre-transaction notification at least 24h before each debit (merchant, amount, date/time, mandate reference, reason) and offer an opt-out. Not required for FASTag/NCMC. AFA-free up to ₹15,000, or ₹1,00,000 for insurance, mutual funds and credit-card bills. The channel varies by issuer. RBI page unreachable; corroborated by many secondary sources.

RBI/2025-26/28 (22 Apr 2025) required banks to migrate to .bank.in (web domains) by 31 Oct 2025. Adoption for email sender domains is per bank. HDFC alerts are observed from hdfcbank.net, hdfcbank.bank.in and hdfcbank.com, so sender trust must key on DKIM d= against a multi-domain registry.
Major US card issuers are believed to offer opt-in per-transaction email alerts, which could give iPhone users near-real-time sensing; not verified in-session.

The FTC's amended Negative Option ('click-to-cancel') Rule was vacated by the Eighth Circuit on 8 July 2025, before its 14 July 2025 compliance date (consistent secondary sources). ROSCA and state auto-renewal laws still apply. A new FTC rulemaking reportedly went to OIRA on 30 Jan 2026 (unverified). Trial and renewal reminder emails are not federally guaranteed.

DPDP Rules, 2025 were notified on 13 Nov 2025, and most data-fiduciary obligations (notice, purpose-specific consent, withdrawal) apply from 13 May 2027. Email-derived purchase data processing for Indian users must be designed to these rules (secondary sources; gazette not fetched).

Near-universal bank/card/UPI SMS alerts. RBI/2017-18/15 (2017-07-06) ¶5: 'Banks must ask their customers to mandatorily register for SMS alerts ... The SMS alerts shall mandatorily be sent'. The PPI Master Direction imposes the same duty on wallet issuers. Read from a verbatim copy of the RBI text; rbi.org.in was blocked, and whether the circular was later consolidated is unverified. Formats verified from 2026 parser fixtures. As of 2026-10-04.

DLT headers XX-ENTITY-S observed live (JD-KOTAKD-S, 2026-05-26). TCCCP (Second Amendment) Regulations 2025, gazetted 2025-02-12, reportedly added the suffixes -P promotional, -S service, -T transactional (bank OTPs) and -G government (secondary). Reference parsers still accept -T/-P/-G headers, so suffixes are hints, not gates. TRAI also publishes a header-to-entity register.

SBI Card and PNB send RCS alerts with display-name senders. A PennyWise PR merged 2026-05-29 says Kotak migrated alerts from SMS to RCS ('Kotak Mahindra Bank', 'Kotak811'), but this rests on a single user report and the scope is unverified. As of 2026-10-04.

RBI Digital Payments – E-mandate Framework, 2026 (reported as RBI/DPSS/2026-27/396, 2026-04-21) §6: a pre-transaction notification at least 24 h before the debit, carrying merchant, amount, date/time, e-mandate reference and reason, with opt-out. FASTag/NCMC auto-replenish exempt. Applies to cards, PPI and UPI. Secondary (TaxGuru reproduction quoted in several repos); rbi.org.in blocked.
Business-side WhatsApp API supports order_details with payment_type upi. Consumer-side read is possible only via the Android notification listener. Prevalence unverified.
M-PESA confirmations from sender MPESA: 10-char code + 'Confirmed', 'New M-PESA balance is Ksh...'.
M-Pesa TZ, Tigo Pesa (rebranded Mixx by Yas, sender MIXXBYYAS; legacy and new templates coexist; twin messages share a TxnID) and Selcom Pesa formats verified from 2026 fixtures/parsers.
M-Pesa Mozambique confirmations in Portuguese ('Confirmado'), with an inline fee ('a taxa foi de') and 11-character transaction codes in every fixture (unlike Kenya's 10).
bKash SMS with TrxID, fee and balance verified; Nagad unverified.
Faysal Bank alerts parsed from app notifications (RAAST/IBFT/debit card formats).
Not established in reachable sources; JazzCash/Easypaisa SMS formats unverified.
GTBank/Access/Zenith/Opay alert formats parsed (9 Nigerian institutions). Bank SMS-alert fees and 'fake credit alert' fraud prevalence unverified.
13 Nepalese institutions parsed by an open-source SMS tracker (coverage proxy).
11 Thai banks parsed (coverage proxy).
9 Ethiopian institutions incl. Telebirr parsed (coverage proxy).
STC Bank RCS purchase alerts parsed.
No parser coverage found; push and e-wallet notifications believed dominant (unverified).
Push and WhatsApp believed dominant; SMS alerts optional (unverified).
Opt-in text alerts exist (Chase short code 24273 format verified); push notifications dominate (prevalence unverified).
Push dominant; e.g. Chase UK alerts are notification-only in the reference parser.
Push dominant (unverified).

Google Play: SMS permissions only for the default SMS handler or an approved Play Console exception, confirmed current in Android docs updated 2026-02-26 (the 'SMS-based money management' exception name is unverified). Android 17 adds a 3 h delay for OTP-bearing SMS for non-exempt apps.

3-hour withholding: SMS-Retriever-hash messages (already before Android 17); WebOTP messages to apps that are not the domain-verified recipient (Android 17, all apps); standard OTP SMS for most apps targeting API 37+. SMS_RECEIVED_ACTION withheld and provider queries filtered. Docs updated 2026-10-01.
No public RCS message API in Telephony; only the notification listener or an undocumented Google Messages MMS-provider route.
Gemini Nano via AICore/ML Kit GenAI (incl. Prompt API) on supported devices only; page updated 2026-09-08.
No third-party access to SMS/RCS/iMessage content.
Unknown senders only; no direct network; cannot write to shared containers; not an ingestion path.
UIPasteControl (iOS 16+) pastes without the paste-permission alert.

A Message personal automation feeding an App Intent. Developer setup guides describe 'When I Receive' + 'Run Immediately' (secondary). Apple's documentation was not reachable, and alphanumeric-sender support and full-body passing are unverified.
Meta's published WhatsApp API (v23.0) is business-side only.
NPCI discontinued P2P UPI collect requests effective 2025-10-01 (circular 2025-07-29). Merchant collect continues, so collect-request SMS are merchant requests. Secondary; npci.org.in blocked.
No UPI; no significant consumer QR payment rail, so the QR scanner mostly yields URLs.

FamilyControls individual authorization (FamilyControlsMember.individual, iOS 16.0+) needs device-owner approval with biometric confirmation. The com.apple.developer.family-controls entitlement must be requested from Apple before App Store submission (the request form is behind Apple ID sign-in). ManagedSettings ShieldSettings covers applications, applicationCategories, webDomains and webDomainCategories with opaque tokens. Authorization always fails in visionOS. Verified 2026-10-04.
ShieldActionResponse.openParentalControlsApp introduced in iOS 26.5; whether it applies to individually authorized apps needs on-device confirmation.
ShieldConfiguration.secondaryButtonSubmenuItems (up to 3) since iOS 26.4.
iOS 26.4 approvedWithDataAccess exposes bundle ids and visited domains only on EU-located devices with EU Apple Accounts; one app per device; separate entitlement.
Outside the EU, authorizationStatus never returns approvedWithDataAccess and FamilyActivityData throws FamilyControlsError.unavailable.
PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS granted by the user via Settings > Special app access > Usage access; foreground events such as ACTIVITY_RESUMED.

Restricted since Android 10. Exceptions include a visible window, a SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW grant, system PendingIntents such as notification taps, and launcher/widget launches. PendingIntent opt-ins: sender opt-in Android 14, creator opt-in Android 15, IntentSender.sendIntent sender opt-in Android 17. Use notifications for launch nudges. As of 2026-05-18.
Technically available; non-accessibility tools (isAccessibilityTool=false) trigger a system privacy notification; Play policy restricts non-accessibility use (2026 text unverified).
Share/action extensions can run JavaScript in the current Safari page via NSExtensionJavaScriptPreprocessingFile.
Safari 14+ macOS, iOS 15+, visionOS 1+; per-site Ask/Allow/Deny grants; distributed inside an app.
Chrome for Android does not run extensions (unverified in this session).

New Firefox extensions must declare data_collection_permissions since 2025-11-03 (older add-ons later). Built-in consent UI in Firefox desktop 140+ and Firefox for Android 142+. Policy 7.3 bans affiliate-tag injection into web content or redirects. Doc dated 2026-03-12.

Archived 2022 Chrome Web Store text (verified) already requires disclosure and related user action before each affiliate code, link or cookie. The 2025-03-11 update and 2025-06-10 enforcement (adding tangible user benefit) come only from secondary reports (unverified); the current policy page was unreachable as of 2026-10-04.
ML Kit Text Recognition v2 ships Latin, Chinese, Devanagari, Japanese and Korean models; no Tamil/Telugu/Bengali models listed.
DataScannerViewController TextContentType.currency since iOS 17.
Vision RecognizeDocumentsRequest (iOS 26) returns structure incl. tables/lists; receipts named as a target.

Foundation Models image prompts with Vision OCRTool/BarcodeReaderTool are iOS/macOS 27.0+ (June 2026 notes) and not available in Simulator. They need an Apple Intelligence-capable device in a supported region. PrivateCloudComputeLanguageModel additionally needs a managed entitlement and eligibility.
ML Kit GenAI Prompt API (text or multimodal) via AICore; supported devices only (device list unverified).
Documented for Android phones (not Android Go); behaviour under Gemini replacing Assistant unverified.
App Shortcuts (iOS 16+) with value prompts; Controls/Action button reuse (iOS 18).

Open Food Facts API: ODbL; 15 product reads/min/IP and 10 searches/min/IP, applied per user for app-originated calls; custom User-Agent required; v2 deprecated, v3 (v3.6) current; food only. As of 2026-10-04.
Issuer-processors expose pre-approval authorization webhooks (e.g. Stripe issuing_authorization.request); requires sponsor bank/compliance; consumer program eligibility unverified.
Would require RBI PPI licence or bank co-brand (unverified).
Some countries (e.g. BR NFC-e, SA ZATCA, IN B2C dynamic QR) print machine-readable fiscal QRs; formats/coverage unverified.

canOpenURL works only for schemes declared in LSApplicationQueriesSchemes: at most 50 entries for apps linked on iOS 15+, and 25 for apps linked on iOS 27+. If several apps register the same scheme, the target app is undefined.
Firefox for Android runs WebExtensions (gecko_android settings; built-in data consent from Firefox for Android 142).

AutofillService (API 26+), enabled by the user in Settings, receives the whole on-screen ViewStructure on field focus, with a browser compatibility mode via accessibility APIs. Technically an in-spend trigger, but BRAKE should avoid it.
A notification can offer up to three action buttons; direct reply via RemoteInput since Android 7.0 (API 24); notification updates are rate-limited. Verified 2026-10-04.
Android 13 (API 33)+ requires the POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission; notifications are off by default for new installs; Google recommends asking in context. Verified 2026-10-04.

Android 15 (API 35) cooldown reduces the appearance, sound volume and vibration of repetitive notifications for up to two minutes. Critical notifications are exempt, and the user can turn cooldown off in Settings. It is described on the notifications guide but not listed on the Android 15 features page. Verified 2026-10-04.

Channels are required since Android 8.0; the app cannot change a channel's importance after creation, only the user can. BRAKE should use separate channels for questions, insights, digest and reminders. Verified 2026-10-04.

iOS 15+: passive, active, timeSensitive and critical. timeSensitive can break through Notification Summary and Focus, and the user can turn off time-sensitive interruptions. relevanceScore (0-1) picks the featured notification in the summary. Verified 2026-10-04.
Category actions appear as buttons; banner notifications display only the first two actions.

App Store Review Guideline 4.5.4: push notifications should not be used to send sensitive personal or confidential information; marketing pushes need explicit opt-in. Affects showing amounts and merchants on the lock screen. Verified 2026-10-04.

CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023 (Gazette Extraordinary No. 783, 30 Nov 2023) list 13 patterns, including confirm shaming, nagging, drip pricing, subscription trap and SaaS billing. 'Nagging' is tied to effecting a transaction for commercial gain, unless the user specifically permitted it. A 5 Jun 2025 advisory asked e-commerce platforms to self-audit within 3 months. Enforcement: a 1 Jun 2026 order fined PhysicsWallah Rs 5 lakh, and a 3 Jun 2026 PIB release reports a Rs 1 lakh fine on McAfee for renewal-prompt confirm shaming. [S] as of 2026-10-04; primary sites blocked.

DSA Art. 25 binds only providers of online platforms and excludes practices covered by the UCPD (2005/29/EC) or the GDPR, so it likely does not apply to BRAKE directly. The UCPD (paywall and cancellation flows) and the GDPR (consent) are the likely operative rules. EDPB Guidelines 03/2022 concern social-media interfaces. Digital Fairness Act status unverified. [S] as of 2026-10-04.

AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689) Art. 5 prohibitions (manipulative or deceptive techniques; exploiting vulnerabilities, including a specific social or economic situation; emotion inference in workplaces and education) apply from 2 Feb 2025 per Art. 113(a) [S]. The Digital Omnibus on AI is reported in force from 27 Jul 2026: it defers Annex III high-risk obligations to 2 Dec 2027 and leaves Art. 5 in place [S]. As of 2026-10-04.

FTC Act s.5 enforcement. CPRA (Civ. Code 1798.140(h)): 'agreement obtained through use of dark patterns does not constitute consent' [S]. The FTC's amended Negative Option ('click-to-cancel') Rule was vacated by the 8th Circuit on 8 Jul 2025, so subscription cancellation falls under ROSCA and state auto-renewal laws (e.g. California AB 2863, effective 1 Jul 2025) [S]. As of 2026-10-04.

Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 9 gives a 14-day withdrawal right for distance and off-premises contracts, which enables 'still returnable' remedies after regret. [S: directive text mirrors] as of 2026-10-04.
country_facts.citation: Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 9 (text via GitHub mirrors of 32011L0083; EUR-Lex blocked)

country_facts.note: No general federal right to return online purchases. The FTC Cooling-Off Rule (16 CFR 429) gives 3 business days only for 'door-to-door sales': $25 or more at the buyer's home, $130 or more at other temporary locations. Remedies otherwise depend on merchant return policies. [S: eCFR mirror] as of 2026-10-04.

No general e-commerce withdrawal or cooling-off right. Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020: r. 5(3)(c) requires marketplaces to disclose return and refund information; r. 6(3) bars sellers from refusing returns or refunds for defective, not-as-described or late goods; r. 4(8) limits cancellation charges. Merchant policy otherwise governs remedies. [S] as of 2026-10-04.

FCA regulation of deferred payment credit (BNPL) has been in force since 15 Jul 2026: creditworthiness checks, disclosure, Financial Ombudsman access, and a temporary-permission window from 15 May to 1 Jul 2026. [S: consistent secondary reports; fca.org.uk blocked] as of 2026-10-04.

Consumer Credit Directive (EU) 2023/2225 (CCD2) Art. 48: transposition by 20 Nov 2025, and Member States 'shall apply those measures from 20 November 2026'. It brings BNPL and small-ticket credit into scope. No postponement was found as of 2026-10-04. [S: EUR-Lex text mirror]

The CFPB's May 2024 interpretive rule treating BNPL lenders as card issuers under Reg Z was withdrawn on 12 May 2025 (Federal Register doc 2025-08286). There is no federal BNPL-specific rule; state laws vary (unverified). [S] as of 2026-10-04.

UK Gambling Commission RTS 12: customer-led limits are only increased at the customer's request, after a 24-hour cooling-off period, and only once the customer takes positive action to confirm at the end of it [S: operator's copy of the RTS, date unknown]. The 48 h app-bank gambling-block delay remains unverified. A precedent for 'tighten now, loosen later, with re-confirmation'.

UPI Lite allows PIN-less small payments. NPCI OC-169A (FY2024-25) set the limits at Rs 1,000 per transaction and Rs 5,000 balance, and OC-205 added auto top-up. This removes UPI's PIN friction for small purchases. The exact circular date is unverified. [S: third-party circular index] as of 2026-10-04.

FCA Consumer Duty (PS22/9) in force since 31 Jul 2023 for regulated firms (consumer understanding, avoiding foreseeable harm); relevant if BRAKE becomes a regulated AISP in the UK. Not fetched this session.

Android 16 (API 36) auto-groups notifications on the app's behalf; if one app posts four or more notifications without a grouping, the system groups them. BRAKE should set explicit groups so user-requested reminders are not bundled with routine insights. The Android 16 and 17 'all apps' behavior-change pages list no other notification changes. Verified 2026-10-04.

The Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 give a 14-day cancellation period for distance contracts; regulated BNPL plans since 15 Jul 2026 also carry a 14-day credit withdrawal right [S]. The CCR 2013 text is unverified this session (legislation.gov.uk blocked).
country_facts.citation: unverified (legislation.gov.uk blocked); BNPL withdrawal right via https://github.com/adedayoagarau/content.md

country_facts.note: pending_transaction_id is set 'where applicable'; 'Not all institutions provide pending transactions'; transactions can be removed by the institution (spec 2020-09-14_1.762.0, as of 2026-10-04). The 'if Plaid matches' docs wording and disappearing holds are unverified (plaid.com blocked).
Add-on to Transactions; statuses MATURE (≥3, or 2 for annual), EARLY_DETECTION, TOMBSTONED; ≥180 days of history recommended; stream modification discontinued.
Only taxonomy for Transactions/Enrich enabled on or after 2025-12-03; earlier customers default to v1 and can opt in.
merchant_category_code is in beta, populated primarily for card transactions, and coverage varies by institution.

In spec since 1.733.0 but flagged x-hidden-from-docs: true in 2020-09-14_1.762.0 (as of 2026-10-04). Posted transactions only, not every institution or transaction, and 'may not reconcile' with /accounts/balance/get. Public availability unverified.
Enrich location schema documents country as US or CA; max 100 transactions per request; coverage statement unverified.
Enrich location schema documents country as US or CA (coverage unverified).
OBTransaction6 (v4.0.1) has no field linking a pending entry to its booked entry; TransactionMutability marks mutable records.

v4.0.1 adds ISO CategoryPurposeCode (GP2P, MP2P, MP2B, SALA, SWEP, TOPG, CASH, CCRD/DCRD…). CCRD/DCRD are defined as 'related to a payment of credit/debit card', which is ambiguous and not a reliable card-bill flag. Production bank adoption unverified.
MerchantDetails{MerchantName, MerchantCategoryCode} is optional in OBTransaction6 (v4.0.1); production population unverified.
TransactionReference 'may … be the FPID in the Faster Payments context'.
Defined in NextGenPSD2 transactionDetails but populated per ASPSP. FinecoBank's v1.3 spec (dated 2019-02-14) marks endToEndId and entryReference 'currently not used'; 2026 status unverified.

mandateId (SEPA mandate) and creditorId (SEPA creditor ID) identify direct-debit series where populated. The BNP/Consorsbank v1.3.6 schema (2020-08-14, updated 2020-11-05) omits creditorId; 2026 status unverified.
CDS v1.36.0: 'no provision in the standards to guarantee the ability to correlate a pending transaction with an associated posted transaction'.
type enum FEE, INTEREST_CHARGED, INTEREST_PAID, TRANSFER_OUTGOING, TRANSFER_INCOMING, PAYMENT, DIRECT_DEBIT, OTHER.
partiePersonType (PESSOA_NATURAL/PESSOA_JURIDICA) and partieCnpjCpf; counterparty identification mandatory for payment transactions since 2023-05-02 (IN BCB 371).

transactionId becomes immutable at TRANSACAO_EFETIVADA. The per-type table requires immutability on D0 for PIX/TED/TEF and on D+1 for DOC/BOLETO/deposits/withdrawals and others (Accounts v2.4.2, latest stable as of 2026-10-04).
32 characters: E + ISPB(8) + yyyyMMddHHmm (UTC submission time, up to ±12 h from SPI processing, so a time bound, not precise) + 11 alphanumerics; unique in SPI.
In the XSD consulted, deposit 'Transactions' are 'all transactions that have been posted'; the Pending element is only an amount. Not re-verified against ReBIT Deposit v2.0.0.

currentBalance ('Available balance') is required in the Sahamati-hosted deposit.xsd. ReBIT Deposit FI schema v2.0.0 replaced v1.x in July 2025 and changed mandatory/optional flags, so re-verify that it is still mandatory in v2.0.0 (unverified as of 2026-10-04).
mode enum CASH, ATM, CARD, UPI, FT, OTHERS (required).

12-character RRN (and OriginalRRN) in Google Cloud Issuer Switch's UPI model, read from a third-party mirror because the canonical googleapis path returned 404 on 2026-10-04. NPCI spec not verified. Presence in SMS, notification and AA narration is unverified per bank.
Payee persona PERSON/ENTITY and payee MCC exist in issuer/PSP data; third parties see them only via QR/intent mc or heuristics.
Mandates carry UMN, amount rule EXACT/MAX, recurrence pattern and rule; pre-debit notification rules (RBI) unverified this session.
The UPI data model's payer account types include CREDIT and PPIWALLET, so UPI debits can be card spend or wallet spend.
Self-serve API not for fee-based services; commercial licence required; explicit end-user consent required.
Recurrence type recurring/subscription/one off plus groups with periodicity (semi-monthly added in SDK 5.6.0, 2026-08-29); country coverage unverified.
Status authorized/pending/booked/rejected/memo and transactionType enum incl. transfer/billPayment/refund; iOS 17.4+ with entitlement; account/country coverage per the FinanceKit stream.

Deposit/RD/TD FI schema v2.0.0 (ReBIT circular dated 2025-01-23). FIPs decommission v1.x before 2025-07-12 and FIUs before 2025-07-27, per Sahamati FAQ. v2 field deltas unverified (ReBIT site blocked).
TransactionId is 'unique and immutable' within the servicing institution but optional. OBTransaction6 requires only AccountId, CreditDebitIndicator, Status, BookingDateTime and Amount (v4.0.1).
BankingTransactionV2.instalmentPlanId links a transaction to an instalment plan; fee and repayment amounts 'may not match a scheduled instalment amount' (CDS v1.36.0).

FIU = 'an entity registered with and regulated by any financial sector regulator'. This is in the 2016 Master Direction para 3(1)(xii) and kept as definition (12) in the RBI (NBFC - Account Aggregator) Directions, 2025. Unregulated BRAKE needs a regulated partner FIU. As of 2026-10-04 [S, verbatim mirror].

DPDP Rules G.S.R. 846(E) dated 13 Nov 2025 (corrigendum G.S.R. 892(E), 10 Dec 2025). Rules 3, 5-16, 22, 23 and the matching Act sections apply from 13 May 2027. No timeline amendment found as of 2026-10-04 [S].
Rule 4 Consent Manager registration commences 13 Nov 2026; no registered operators verified as of 2026-10-04 [S].
Google Play lists 'SMS-based money management' (READ_SMS, RECEIVE_SMS, RECEIVE_MMS, RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH) as an exception; declaration and Google approval required [S].
RBI 6 Apr 2018 circular requires payment system providers to store payment data only in India; applies to BRAKE only via partner flow-downs, but India hosting is the pragmatic default [U].
CERT-In Directions No. 20(3)/2022-CERT-In of 28 Apr 2022: report cyber incidents within 6 hours; keep ICT logs for 180 days in India [S, verbatim mirror]. Logs must be content-free.
Until DPDP commencement omits IT Act s.43A, SPDI Rules 2011 treat bank/card/payment-instrument details as sensitive personal data requiring written consent and reasonable security practices [U].

2024 rule under E.D. Ky. preliminary injunction (Oct 2025), enjoined not vacated. The 1 Apr 2026 first compliance date never took effect. Reconsideration NPRM sent to OIRA in early Aug 2026 (reported 6 Aug); FR publication unconfirmed as of 2026-10-04 [S]. Access relies on aggregator contracts.

Assume BRAKE is a GLBA 'financial institution' if it processes aggregated account data [U]. 16 CFR 314.4(j)(1): FTC notice 'as soon as possible, and no later than 30 days after discovery' for events involving 'at least 500 consumers' [S, verbatim mirror]; effective 13 May 2024 [U]. Also encryption, MFA and 2-year disposal [U].

Civ. Code 1798.140(ae)(1)(E): 'The contents of a consumer's mail, email, and text messages unless the business is the intended recipient of the communication' [S, verbatim mirror]. Whether purely on-device parsing is 'collection' is open. GLBA exemption is data-level; CPPA ADMT/risk regs effective 1 Jan 2026 [U].

RCW 19.373.010(8) covers 'use or purchase of prescribed medication' and data 'derived or extrapolated from nonhealth information ... including algorithms or machine learning'. Separate consent to collect/share; private right of action via the WA CPA. Directly affects 'Medical'/pharmacy labels [S, verbatim mirror].

ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3) still governs. The ePrivacy Regulation proposal was withdrawn (OJ C/2025/5423, 6 Oct 2025) [S]. The Digital Omnibus COM(2025) 837 would move the terminal-equipment rules into the GDPR but was not adopted as of Sep 2026 [S]. Consent likely required per device-reading source [U].

Provisional agreement 27 Nov 2025; ECON endorsement May 2026; formal adoption and OJ publication unconfirmed as of 2026-10-04 [S]. AIS permission dashboards [U]. Application expected about 18 months after entry into force [S].

In force since 2 Feb 2025: bans manipulative or deceptive techniques and the exploitation of economic-situation vulnerabilities [U]. The Omnibus adds new Art. 5 prohibitions from 2 Dec 2026 [S]. BRAKE interventions must be user-configured and non-deceptive.
Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (Royal Assent 19 Jun 2025). Section 80 Arts 22A-22D replace UK GDPR Art. 22 and have been in force since 5 Feb 2026 (SI 2026/82) [S].
Android 15+: untrusted NotificationListenerService apps cannot read unredacted content of notifications where an OTP is detected [V].

gmail.readonly and gmail.metadata are Restricted [S]. q cannot be used under gmail.metadata [V, discovery rev. 20260928]. Annual security assessment and Letter of Assessment for qualifying apps [V]. Limited Use includes derived data [V]. No generalised/non-personalised AI training [S].
App Review 5.1.2(i): disclose and obtain explicit permission before sharing personal data with third parties including third-party AI [V].

Limited Use covers all extension-handled data. Policy update effective 1 Aug 2026: data must be 'strictly necessary to the extension's disclosed single purpose' and all collection must be prominently disclosed [S; primary blog not fetched; the earlier AI-generated-artifact citation was removed].
Gemini Nano via AICore (no record of inputs/outputs stored) and Apple Foundation Models on-device, on supported devices only [V].

From 13 May 2027: Rule 6(1)(e) requires keeping logs and personal data for one year. Rule 8(3) sets a minimum one-year retention of 'personal data, associated traffic data and other logs of the processing'. It conflicts with aggressive raw-data deletion; counsel must decide the scope, including on-device processing [S, verbatim mirror].

Since Oct 2024, Play Protect enhanced fraud protection in India blocks internet-sideloaded apps requesting RECEIVE_SMS, READ_SMS, notification-listener or accessibility access; adb installs reportedly exempt. Distribute Indian betas via Play testing tracks [S].

Art. 50 transparency (disclose AI interaction) has applied since 2 Aug 2026. Not delayed by the Digital Omnibus on AI, Reg. (EU) 2026/1744, in force 27 Jul 2026, which deferred Annex III high-risk to 2 Dec 2027 [S]. 'Ask BRAKE' must disclose AI.

Android 17, apps targeting API 37+: standard SMS containing an OTP (not WebOTP or SMS Retriever format) are withheld for 3 hours; the SMS_RECEIVED broadcast is held back and provider queries are filtered [V]. Test bank-alert parsing before raising targetSdk.
Notification listeners cannot get access or be bound on low-RAM devices running Android Q (10) and below; listeners in work profiles are ignored [V].
Eligibility limited to apps distributed in the US or UK App Store.
Eligibility limited to US/UK distribution as of 2026-10.
iOS 26+ only; frequencies hourly, daily, weekly ('within an hour of data updating'). Only relevant where FinanceKit itself is available (US, GB).

Individual authorization iOS 16+; distribution entitlement must be requested from Apple. The action handler and app see only opaque tokens; the sandboxed ShieldConfigurationDataSource receives display names and bundle IDs for rendering only. App Review 4.10 forbids monetizing Screen Time APIs. As of 2026-10-04.
Up to three actions, displayed only when the notification is expanded; a RemoteInput direct-reply action is one of the three, not an extra.

Fi's banking front-end on Federal Bank reportedly wound down (2026-03-11), with >3.5M users moved to FedMobile. Search summary only: TechCrunch, Fi and Federal Bank pages were blocked, so the figures are unverified against a primary source. Partner-bank fintech layers can be withdrawn.
GoCardless stopped accepting new Bank Account Data accounts from July 2025; existing accounts continue.
No new accounts since July 2025; alternatives include Enable Banking (experimental in Actual).
User-paid $1.50/month or $15/year; ≤90 days of history; ~daily refresh via MX.
Intuit Mint shut down by 2024-03-23; users directed to Credit Karma, which lacks budgeting and month-over-month trends.
Actual Budget bank-sync provider marked experimental; set-up via my.akahu.nz (NZ mapping confirmed). As of 2026-10-04.
Actual Budget bank-sync provider marked experimental; Meu Pluggy connects to 'Open Finance Brasil' (BR mapping confirmed). As of 2026-10-04.
RBI 2020 card-security directions reportedly require issuers to let cardholders toggle online, international and contactless use and set limits (unverified this session).
Many UK banks reportedly offer MCC-based gambling blocks with a cooling-off delay before removal, e.g. 48h at Monzo (unverified this session).

Not an enforced right as of 2026-10-04: Plaid's OpenAPI (2020-09-14_1.762.0) says its 1033 reauthorization field is 'not currently used ... if 1033-related expiration begins to be enforced'. Reports of an injunction and CFPB reconsideration are unverified. US access rests on aggregator contracts.

Android 17: WebOTP SMS withheld for 3 h from apps that are not the domain-verified recipient (all apps); for apps targeting API 37, standard OTP-bearing SMS are also withheld 3 h (SMS_RECEIVED_ACTION withheld, provider queries filtered). Default SMS app and companion apps exempt. As of 2026-10-01 docs.
iOS/iPadOS 26.5+: ShieldActionResponse.openParentalControlsApp opens the app that applied the shield; earlier versions need a notification workaround.

As of 2026-10-04, the ReBIT deposit FI schema (Sahamati copy) has transaction attributes txnId, type, mode (CASH/ATM/CARD/UPI/FT/OTHERS), amount, currentBalance, transactionTimestamp, valueDate, narration and reference, with no MCC or merchant field. The merchant must be parsed from the narration.

The ReBIT credit_card FI schema v1.0 (Sahamati copy) has a required mcc attribute on each Transaction, plus a Summary with dueDate, totalDueAmount and minDueAmount. How often FIPs actually populate it is unverified, and the sample instance shows mcc="".
AA consent purpose code 102 is 'Customer spending patterns, budget or other reportings'. Periodic fetches are capped at 1 per hour (24 per day), per Setu's documentation citing the AA spec.

As of 2026-10-04, per a secondary transcription of NPCI UPI Linking Spec v1.6 (Nov 2017), mc (MCC) is OPTIONAL in upi://pay payloads, while pa and pn are mandatory and tr is mandatory for merchant and dynamic links. A BRAKE QR scan yields the MCC before payment only when the merchant QR includes mc. The primary NPCI spec was blocked (unverified against the primary).

Plaid Transaction provides merchant_name, merchant_entity_id, counterparties[] with type and confidence_level, personal_finance_category v1/v2, payment_channel (online, in store, other), and location for physical stores (as of OpenAPI 2020-09-14_1.762.0).
Plaid merchant_category_code is a beta field, populated mainly for card transactions; coverage varies by institution and values may change.
Clients that enabled Transactions or Enrich on or after 2025-12-03 can receive only the PFC v2 taxonomy; earlier clients default to v1.

FinanceKit Transaction has merchantName and merchantCategoryCode (Int16). US coverage requires iOS 17.4+ and is limited to Apple Card, Apple Cash and Savings. Access needs a managed entitlement and a Finance-category app.

As of 2026-10-04, UK FinanceKit requires iOS 18.4+ and uses open banking with institutions 'including' Barclays, Barclaycard, First Direct, Halifax, HSBC, Lloyds, M&S Bank, MBNA, Monzo, Nationwide, NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland and Santander. This is not presented as an exhaustive list.

UK Open Banking AIS v4.0.1 defines MerchantDetails (MerchantName, a 3-4 character MerchantCategoryCode) and CardInstrument.AuthorisationType (ConsumerDevice, Contactless, None, PIN). These fields are conditional, so population varies by bank.

Berlin Group card-account transactions include merchantCategoryCode (exactly 4 characters), cardAcceptorId, cardAcceptorAddress, terminalId and acceptorTransactionDateTime. Bank support for card-account endpoints is unverified.

CDR banking v1.36.0 BankingTransactionV2 includes merchantName and merchantCategoryCode for outgoing merchant payments, plus BPAY billerCode, billerName and crn. The standard does not guarantee correlation between pending and posted transactions.

Open Finance Brasil credit-cards API 2.3.0, and the newer 2.3.1 patch, expose payeeMCC as type number, format integer, so leading zeros are lost. Both accept a creditCardPayeeMCC filter (checked 2026-10-04).
Pix BR Code (EMV QR) generators commonly set tag 52 (MCC) to 0000, which gives no category signal. This is an implementation convention; the BCB manual was unreachable (unverified).

In EMV merchant-presented QR, tag 52 (MCC), 59 (merchant name) and 60 (merchant city) are mandatory. Tags 01 (point of initiation: 11 static, 12 dynamic), 61 (postal code) and 62 (additional data) are optional. Checked against an open-source parser because emvco.com was blocked; population quality varies by national scheme.

The Overture Places September 2026 release has 81,455,423 places (about 81.5M), under CDLA-Permissive-2.0, Apache-2.0 or CC0, with no OSM data. categories was removed in favour of taxonomy (about 2,300 categories) and basic_category (about 280 labels). Places is released monthly and the taxonomy quarterly, and the July 2026 release caused one-time GERS ID churn.
The name-suggestion-index is BSD-3 licensed and maps brands to Wikidata IDs and OSM tags, scoped by country through locationSet. On 2026-10-04 it held 507 cafe brands and 1,049 supermarket brands.

Commercially available. The non-EEA Service Specific Terms (last modified 2026-06-10) forbid using Places content with a non-Google map (14.2) and cap lat/lng caching at 30 days (14.3); place_id is cacheable. EEA billing accounts fall under separate, stricter EEA terms. Pricing unverified.

Limited to 100 geofences per app per device user. Requires ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION plus ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION when targeting API 29+. Latency is usually under 2 minutes and up to 6 when the device is stationary.
Core Location limits any app to 20 monitored conditions at once (CLMonitor).

The Android 17 (API 37) location button grants precise location for the current session only. Google Play requires it for apps targeting Android 17 whose location features are all session-based. Experimental.
iOS 17+ EventKit write-only access (requestWriteOnlyAccessToEvents) lets an app add events without reading the calendar, and EventKitUI can add events with no calendar permission.
Adding an event through the ACTION_INSERT intent needs no READ_CALENDAR or WRITE_CALENDAR permission.
The Google Calendar scope calendar.app.created lets an app create secondary calendars and manage events only on those calendars.
ACTION_TIMEZONE_CHANGED is exempt from Android's background-broadcast limits, so the app still receives it, and it needs no permission. Usable as a permission-free travel signal.

The ReBIT deposit transactionTimestamp is xs:dateTime, so a timezone offset is allowed but not required. The sample instance includes one. Whether FIPs send real times of day rather than a default midnight is unverified.

Plaid authorized_datetime 'is returned for select financial institutions' and 'may contain default time values (such as 00:00:00)', per OpenAPI 2020-09-14_1.762.0 as of 2026-10-04. Time-of-day features must abstain when it is missing or at midnight.

For EEA billing accounts, the EEA Service Specific Terms (last modified 2026-06-10) say: §15.1, apart from lat/lng and place_id, Places content must not be used with any map; §15.2, use is limited to the 'Places API EEA Permitted Uses'; §15.4, lat/lng caching is capped at 30 days.

iOS posts NSNotification.Name.NSSystemTimeZoneDidChange when the time zone changes. It is delivered through NotificationCenter to a running app; background wake is unverified. Compare the time zone on launch or resume. Checked 2026-10-04.
All the Places publishes CC-0 chain-store POIs as GeoJSON with brand:wikidata, from a weekly spider run (README, as of 2026-10-04).
